functional.summary: Live E2E on the host against the real client workbooks. Signed in with the mock OTP, opened MIS Reports, selected Agriculture / Nursery / Agri - Nursery - DUB / 2026-07-01 and pressed Generate: the Financial MIS statement renders INLINE below the selector, 106 body rows at the workbook's natural depth, headed 'Nursery - DUB' with 'Active period: July 2026'. It RECONCILES EXACTLY to the known figures - the grand total reads Budget Rs 1,00,50,136 and Actual Rs 1,15,12,712 at 114.6% for July, and Budget Rs 2,59,13,990 for FY 26-27 YTD, which is April+May+June+July (3,331,754.98 + 6,068,254.21 + 6,463,844.56 + 10,050,136.29 = 25,913,990.04) to the rupee. Parent subtotals foot against their own children: Vehicle Maintenance (9.01) shows Rs 20,000 budget and Rs 26,500 actual over children Rs 18,000 + Rs 2,000 and Rs 22,500 + Rs 4,000. Parents carry no GL code and leaves carry theirs; the nil rule renders NA for 0/0; Roll-over is present and empty; ZERO occurrences of NaN on the page.
non_blocking_findings: The statement shows S.No '31' for a Land Levelling line where 3.1 would be expected. This is NOT a parsing defect: the source workbook's cell holds the NUMBER 31 (raw value 31, while the row below correctly holds 3.2), so the statement faithfully renders what the client's file says. Inferring 3.1 would be the kind of guess this project has consistently refused; it is a data-quality item for Srihari, like the stray 2099-11-01 month in the SAP workbook.
residual_risks: The first attempt returned 403 from SelectionExecutor.authorize because the running app-db carried none of the five mis-statement grants that statement-api added to migrate.ts - the migration had not been applied since. Running db:migrate seeded them and the statement rendered. The CODE is correct; the risk is deployment-shaped: a new governed domain needs its grant migration applied before the route works, and nothing surfaces that as anything more specific than a 403.
The unresolvable outcome is not walked live - the single-selection master makes it unreachable from the UI - and is proven by the component test instead, as the approved plan states.
FY-YTD Actual equals July Actual because only the July actuals batch is ingested; the YTD Budget correctly spans four months. That is the data, not a bug.
